linear.formula: reshape(W @ flatten(S)) + original H_post branch distribution

mlp.formula: reshape(W_up @ relu(W_down @ flatten(S))) + original H_post branch distribution

shared: Original NVIDIA H_pre/H_post, aggregate-after-routing branch RMSNorm, backbone, final collapse, softcap15 and full NTP objective
exclusions: No extra identity bypass, no bias in mixers, no added normalization, gate, auxiliary loss, Sinkhorn or generated matrices
layout: flatten existing channel-major,stream-minor layout; nn.Linear weight is output,input
optimizer: New static mixing 2D matrices use default Muon groups/LR/WD; read/write and final collapse retain AdamW; backbone hyperparameters unchanged
precision: BF16 activations/GEMMs,FP32 master weights; unchanged NVIDIA routing precision

gate.profile: same-device original mHC,current channel-local,and two new mixers;20warmup+40timed each
gate.restart: each new variant25->exit85->fresh process128,full305176-step LR horizon
gate.probe: init and step128 fixed2K dev forward/backward scales; no optimizer step
gate.logging: local only,no credentials or returned weights

monitoring: 300-second polling until first finite formal step for each variant,then stop
existing_run: channel-local7816910.0 and immutable inputs remain untouched; no permission to cancel it
limitations: MLP mixing has a512-dimensional bottleneck and cannot initialize to the full2048-dimensional identity; short stability checks do not establish long-run quality. Mixer GEMMs halve in MLP variant; whole-model FLOPs do not halve.
